section.h2: Free Appliance Pickup for Washers, Dryers, Refrigerators & More
section.p: Free Reliable Appliance Pickup helps customers submit qualifying major appliances for pickup review. If you are searching for free appliance pickup near me, use one of our city pages below or submit your city and ZIP code through our pickup request form.
We review appliance condition, photos, city, ZIP code, floor level, stairs and pickup access before confirming service. Availability varies by location and current local demand.
Our most important pickup categories include washers, dryers, washer and dryer sets, refrigerators, stoves, ranges and freezers.

div.p: Qualifying top-load and front-load washing machines are a priority pickup category. Send clear photos and the washer's current condition.
Qualifying electric and gas dryers may be available for pickup from accessible locations.
Washer and dryer sets are especially welcome for review. Matching brands are not required.
Qualifying full-size refrigerators may be considered, including top-freezer, bottom-freezer, side-by-side and French-door models.
Qualifying electric and gas stoves and ranges may be submitted for appliance pickup review.
Qualifying upright and chest freezers may be considered depending on condition, access and local availability.
Dishwashers may qualify depending on appliance condition, accessibility and current local demand.
Have several major appliances? Include all appliances in one request and send clear photos of each item.
Qualifying appliances may be removed for reuse, refurbishment, parts recovery or appropriate recycling.

section.div: Microwaves: Standalone microwaves are generally not accepted. A microwave may be considered with another qualifying major appliance.

div.p: Common requests include washers, dryers, washer and dryer sets, refrigerators, stoves and ranges, freezers, dishwashers and other qualifying major household appliances.

div.p: Qualifying washers, dryers and washer and dryer sets are priority pickup categories. Submit photos, condition and pickup location for review.

div.p: Working, repairable and non-working appliances can be submitted. Pickup is not guaranteed and depends on the individual request and local availability.
